spec.description: VF-010 (verification/findings.md, closed) changed the own checker's branch probes from a wall-clock budget to a budget in solver conflicts (Engine::probe, lib/src/bmc/mod.rs, commit f606b0d8). Its brief (llm-dlc/loops/cleanup-native.md, N1) also asks that no recorded own-checker verdict change. Jobs 20261107-183538-vf-010-s-benchmark-at-the-fix-run-1-of-2 (at f606b0d8) and 20261107-183544-vf-010-s-benchmark-at-the-fix-s-parent-r (at its parent c307e721) ran the benchmark's own-checker runs and both passed; their gitignored outputs lib/target/benchmark-native-vf010-{fix,parent}.json are in the runner's repository (four directories above $VERIFY_WORKDIR), applied to lib/target/ or kept under verification/results/ID/outputs/. This job finds each by the sha256 its run recorded and compares every own-checker run by (case, mode), as the examples stream's VF-014 comparison (20261107-183328-...) does. It exits 1 if a verdict differs or a case is in one run and not the other, 2 if an output is missing or not the recorded one. Tried on the same files before submitting: 557 runs, 0 verdicts changed, 0 formulas grown past 10%, 0 paths or merges changed. VF-021 (the runner stopping the first pair with each other's systemd scope) closes when this passes, since the resubmitted pair ran through.
